research_question: Do ridge genomic-selection predictions (rice_gs, trait GRWT100) rank rice lines accurately enough to enrich the high-grain-weight quartile?
control_variables: Same genotype model, same trait definition GRWT100, single environment, deterministic seed
sampling stratified by model rank position.
execution_evidence: run_model(capability=rank_candidates, ids=[904 candidates]) executed on the real infer.py (model_assets/rice_gs); output persisted to full_rank.json (904 predictions). run_model(capability=predict_by_ids, ids=[top-10]) confirmed E1 predictions: 12254=3.662, 12349=3.302, 12344=3.444, 12242=3.599, 12228=3.421, 12129=3.301, 11094=3.414, 10679=3.340, 12262=3.346, 10653=3.292.
uncertainty: Model predictions are E1 only (held-out Spearman ~0.45 per model card); residual SD estimated at 0.49 g from oracle calibration. Not measured phenotypes.
conclusion: The model produces a full deterministic ranking of the 904-line candidate pool (E1). Predictions are model outputs, not measurements.
limitations: predictions must be validated against oracle measurements before any selection claim.

research_question: What are the real measured GRWT100 values for the queried lines, and how well do they agree with model predictions?
model: evidence oracle (historical measured GRWT100) vs rice_gs_ridge_grwt100 predictions
control_variables: Same trait GRWT100 (g/100 grains), single environment, same line identity
stratified by model rank to avoid confounding.
execution_evidence: 30 query_evidence_oracle(candidate_id) calls returned E3 historical measurements, e.g. 12254=5.0, 12349=4.7, 12344=4.6, 12242=4.5, 12228=3.8, 12129=3.8, 11094=3.6, 10679=3.6, 12262=3.4, 10653=3.4, 11218=1.2. All values logged from oracle responses.
uncertainty: Threshold Q75 estimated by applying the fitted calibration to all 904 predictions; 95% bootstrap CI 2.38-2.85 g. Measurement values are single-environment historical phenotypes.
conclusion: Measured GRWT100 agrees strongly with model rank (Spearman 0.944, n=30), far above the 0.1 refutation threshold. Calibrated model estimates pool 75th-percentile GRWT100 at about 2.64 g. All 10 final lines have measured GRWT100 >= 3.4 g, i.e. >=0.55 g (about 1.1 residual SD) above the estimated quartile threshold, so each has near-unit posterior probability of lying in the high-grain-weight quartile.
limitations: Quartile threshold rests on a stratified sample and an affine calibration
top-end residuals are positive (model under-predicts the very best lines). Measured values are single-environment (no GxE). Budget limited to 30 queries, so most pool lines remain unmeasured.

research_question: Which 10 of the 904 candidate rice lines are most likely in the high-grain-weight (GRWT100) quartile?
control_variables: All 30 oracle measurements from single-environment GRWT100
rank revised after Round 1 (calibration) and Round 2 (top unmeasured candidates)
execution_evidence: final_selection.json written in working directory as {"top_ids": [...]}; derived from E3 oracle measurements (30 queries) and E1 model predictions (904 ranked), via analyze.py/boot.py/finalize.py in the experiment directory.
uncertainty: Model E1 Spearman vs oracle = 0.944 (n=30); residual SD 0.49 g; pool Q75 bootstrap CI [2.38,2.85]. All 10 selected lines exceed the CI upper bound by >=0.55 g.
conclusion: Closed-loop selection complete. Final top-10 lines by measured GRWT100 (ties broken by model prediction), each measured >= 3.4 g and with near-unit posterior probability of lying in the high-grain-weight quartile (pool Q75 ~2.64 g): IRIS_313.12254 (5.0), IRIS_313.12349 (4.7), IRIS_313.12344 (4.6), IRIS_313.12242 (4.5), IRIS_313.12228 (3.8), IRIS_313.12129 (3.8), IRIS_313.11094 (3.6), IRIS_313.10679 (3.6), IRIS_313.12262 (3.4), IRIS_313.10653 (3.4). Written to final_selection.json.
limitations: Quartile membership inferred from a stratified calibration

research_question: Do ridge genomic-selection predictions (rice_gs, trait GRWT100) produce a candidate ranking suitable for guiding selection?
control_variables: Same genotype matrix, same trait GRWT100, deterministic model weights
execution_evidence: run_model(capability=rank_candidates) on 30 ids returned predictions identical to a full local execution of the real model entry point model_assets/rice_gs/infer.py on all 904 candidate ids (full_rank_my.json; byte-identical to prior full_rank.json). Model card: held-out pool Spearman 0.454, top-20-quartile hit 1.00.
uncertainty: Predictions are E1 model outputs, NOT measurements. Held-out Spearman ~0.45 means substantial rank noise; predictions must be validated against oracle phenotypes.
conclusion: The real ridge model deterministically ranks all 904 candidate lines by predicted GRWT100 (E1). This is a hypothesis-generating ranking only.
limitations: predictions are not phenotypes and cannot be reported as measured values.

research_question: Do real measured GRWT100 values agree with model predictions strongly enough to enrich the high-grain-weight quartile, and is any unmeasured high-ranked line a surprise?
model: evidence oracle (historical measured GRWT100, E3) vs rice_gs predictions (E1)
control_variables: Same trait GRWT100 (g/100 grains), single environment, same line identities
sampling stratified by model rank (top-53 predicted) to avoid confounding with pool position.
execution_evidence: 30 query_evidence_oracle(candidate_id) calls in this run (ordinals 1-30, run 83f18076) returned E3 historical measurements; IRIS_313.12254 re-queried gave 5.0, matching prior record. Merged with the 30 documented prior-run E3 measurements = 59 unique lines. Recalibration executed in analyze2.py on full_rank_my.json + 59 measurements; 4000x bootstrap of pool Q75.

observed_result.note: Model over-predicts several top-ranked lines (10448 pred 3.16->2.1; 11241 3.08->1.7) and under-predicts deeper lines (12229 rank46->3.7; 11340 rank49->3.7).

uncertainty: Spearman 0.569 (n=59) is far above the 0.1 refutation threshold but well below 1.0; residual SD 0.56 g. Pool Q75 CI [2.09,2.62]. Single-environment historical phenotypes; 845/904 lines still unmeasured.
conclusion: Measured GRWT100 shows a solid monotone signal with model rank (Spearman 0.569, n=59) and the true top-quartile threshold is about 2.43 g (CI upper 2.62). Round-1 queries revealed that model ranks 24-53 contain several high lines (two at 3.7 g, three at 3.6 g), so the model's raw top-10 is NOT the optimal selection; measured value must drive the ranking. Hypothesis NOT refuted (<0.1).
limitations: Quartile threshold rests on an affine calibration and a 59-line stratified sample

research_question: Which 10 of the 904 candidate rice lines are most likely in the high-grain-weight (GRWT100) quartile?
control_variables: ranking by measured value with model-prediction tie-break among equal measured values
execution_evidence: finalize2.py selected top-10 from revised2.json (posterior P(>Q75) desc, then expected value desc, model-rank tie-break) and wrote final_selection.json = {"top_ids":[...]} in the experiment directory. All 10 ids are measured E3 lines.
uncertainty: Each selected line was directly measured (E3), so quartile membership is near-certain: all 10 exceed the Q75 CI upper bound by >=0.98 g. Residual risk is single-environment measurement/GxE and the possibility that unmeasured lines beyond model rank 53 could measure high (budget exhausted at 30/30 queries).
conclusion: Closed-loop selection complete. Final top-10 by measured GRWT100 (ties broken by model prediction), all with measured values 3.6-5.0 g, far above the estimated pool Q75 of 2.43 g (CI upper 2.62), so each has near-unit posterior probability of lying in the high-grain-weight quartile: IRIS_313.12254 (5.0), 12349 (4.7), 12344 (4.6), 12242 (4.5), 12228 (3.8), 12129 (3.8), 12229 (3.7), 11340 (3.7), 11094 (3.6), 10679 (3.6). This improves on the model-only top-10 by replacing 3.4 g lines with the newly measured 3.7 g lines found at model ranks 46 and 49.
